incidents.name: VTSwapHook pre-fee reserve update
incidents.notes: VTSwapHook priced its nonlinear VT/T curve on fee-adjusted amounts but wrote back reserves using the full pre-fee specified amount, so alternating an exact-input ATH->vATH swap with an exact-output vATH->ATH swap left the caller with positive Uniswap V4 PoolManager deltas in both currencies.

sources.ref: onchain review: VTSwapHook 0xbf4b4A83708474528A93C123F817e7f2A0637a88 created 2025-07-25T09:06:29Z by 0x1e1840f1eb9d9b89f4b1f2ad469e31e9877b820d, not the attack-tx sender 0xf378840de079c70f55218cd3af99d2d81ba154ba; no EIP-1967 events, 245.7 days old. Loss stated only in vATH and ATH, whose price is bound to the exploited pool, so no USD figure is asserted; at the widely quoted ATH price of a few cents the 2.0M ATH leg alone is far above the $1,000 floor.
